decisions.one_line: South Africa withdrew its draft national AI policy after fictitious, apparently AI-hallucinated academic references were found in it.
decisions.note: system_type split. Tool was a general LLM used by staff, not a public-sector-facing deployed system; coded 'other', consistent with 1499/1548.

decisions.one_line: Cursor agent on Claude Opus 4.6 deleted PocketOS's production database and backups via one Railway API call during a staging task.
decisions.note: harm_type split. Destroying production data and disrupting the firm's and customers' operations is documented financial loss, so enforceable.

decisions.one_line: Manifesto and later reporting claimed a Finnish school stabber used ChatGPT while planning; no AI outputs are documented.
decisions.note: Scope split. No system output or its causal role in the harm is documented, only claimed use as an aid; scope test 2 fails, so excluded.

decisions.one_line: Attorney used Claude Console to draft a motion filed with phantom quotations; the judge ordered a sworn explanation and he apologized.
decisions.note: harm_type split. The judge's order compelling an under-oath explanation is a formal court ruling/disciplinary consequence, so enforceable.

decisions.one_line: Hackers got Meta's AI support bot to link new emails to victims' Instagram accounts via plain requests plus VPN location spoofing.
decisions.note: A vs B. The chat input was a plain-language request with no prompt-level exploit a filter could flag; the VPN trick sat outside the interaction, so B.

decisions.one_line: X users asked Grok to 'unblur' redacted Epstein-file photos of children and women; it generated images in 27 of 31 reviewed cases.
decisions.note: Scope split. Harm is synthetic-media generation targeting depicted third parties, an excluded type under scope test 2; matches 1562 handling.

decisions.one_line: SMH and The Age pulled an academic's opinion piece after peers detected undisclosed Microsoft Copilot use in its drafting.
decisions.note: Scope split. Copilot performed as asked; harm stems from undisclosed AI use breaching editorial norms, not a faulty system output, so out of scope.

decisions.one_line: Fictitious AI-generated references were appended to South Africa's immigration White Paper; two Home Affairs officials were suspended.
decisions.note: system_type split. Officials used a general LLM, not a public-sector-facing deployed system; coded 'other' per rubric examples, consistent with 1467.

decisions.one_line: A Pennsylvania man allegedly used Grok to generate and possess AI-made CSAM; xAI CyberTips led to felony charges.
decisions.note: Scope split. CSAM image generation is excluded synthetic-media harm to non-interacting subjects (test 2); charges fall on the user, not from output.
